npcs.name: The Prophet
npcs.greet: They laugh at me in the street. Let them. Something old is waking under the Heartland, and the Nine have no knights left to meet it.

npcs.name: Sir Amiel Lannus
npcs.greet: The Priory has been empty for a long time. I kept the lamps lit anyway. Someone had to believe the order would come back.

relics.name: Wayshrine Ember
relics.desc: A coal from the Shrine of the Crusader that does not burn the hand. It glows brighter near Pelinal's relics.

relics.name: Helm of the Crusader
relics.desc: Pelinal Whitestrake's helm, dented and blackened, and still warm under the dust.

relics.name: Gauntlets of the Crusader
relics.desc: Heavy steel gauntlets worn by Pelinal in the war against the Ayleid sorcerer-kings.

relics.name: Mace of the Crusader
relics.desc: A flanged mace blessed in Stendarr's name. Undead things flinch from its shadow.

kn9_vision: The shrine is cold until you kneel. Then the air fills with the sound of a great battle, very far away and very long ago.
I was the Divines' hound, and I hunted the Ayleid kings until the last of them knelt. One I could not finish. Umaril. He is coming back.
My helm and gauntlets lie with my knights near Anvil. My mace lies where the elves hid it. Take them up. Finish what I began.
kn9_umaril_falls: You strike down my flesh, little knight. Flesh I can spare. Meridia's realm keeps my spirit. I will walk out of it again.
Umaril's body crumbles into golden ash, but a light flees upward from it, into the dark of the ruin, and is gone.
kn9_crusader: The avatar of Umaril breaks apart in a storm of light. For a long moment the ruin is silent. Then, somewhere far above, bells ring.
It is finished. The Nine see you, Divine Crusader. Keep the order, and keep the faith, when no one else does.

quests.title: Pilgrimage of the Nine
quests.pitch: That the Nine need knights again. Not soldiers. Knights. If you would be one, walk the pilgrimage: pray at the chapels of Kvatch, Skingrad and Chorrol, and come to the Priory of the Nine outside Kvatch. Sir Amiel waits there.
quests.desc: A street preacher in Anvil who calls himself the Prophet asked me to walk a pilgrimage to the chapels of the Nine, and then present myself at the Priory of the Nine near Kvatch.

objectives.text: Pray at the rebuilt Chapel of Akatosh in Kvatch
objectives.journal: Kvatch's chapel is still half scaffolding. A mason stopped work to let me pray, and did not ask why.

objectives.text: Pray at the Chapel of Julianos in Skingrad
Pray at the Great Chapel of Stendarr in Chorrol
Present yourself to Sir Amiel Lannus at the Priory of the Nine
objectives.topic: The Prophet sent me. I've walked the pilgrimage.
objectives.reply: Then the Prophet was right, and I was right to wait. Kneel. In the name of the Nine, I accept you as a knight of this order. There are few of us. There will be more.

quests.outro: I walked the pilgrimage of the Nine and was received into the Knights of the Nine by Sir Amiel Lannus at the Priory near Kvatch.

consequence.summary: I walked the pilgrimage of the Nine and was received into the Knights of the Nine by Sir Amiel Lannus at the Priory near Kvatch.

quests.title: The Shrine of the Crusader
quests.desc: Sir Amiel believes the spirit of Pelinal Whitestrake, the Divine Crusader, can still be reached at a forgotten shrine in the hills near Kvatch, and that it will tell us where his relics lie.

objectives.text: Find the Shrine of the Crusader
Kneel at the shrine
Tell Sir Amiel what you saw
objectives.topic: Pelinal spoke to me. Umaril the Unfeathered is returning.
objectives.reply: Umaril. The Ayleid sorcerer Pelinal fought to the last. If he's returning, we will need every relic the Crusader left. Follow the ember.

quests.outro: At the Shrine of the Crusader I saw Pelinal Whitestrake, who warned that Umaril the Unfeathered is returning, and told me where his relics lie.

consequence.summary: At the Shrine of the Crusader I saw Pelinal Whitestrake, who warned that Umaril the Unfeathered is returning, and told me where his relics lie.

quests.title: Relics of the Whitestrake
quests.desc: Pelinal's helm and gauntlets were laid with the first knights of his order in an ossuary near Anvil. The dead there do not welcome visitors.

objectives.text: Travel to the Ossuary of the Knights
Lay the restless dead of the ossuary to rest
Take the Helm of the Crusader
Take the Gauntlets of the Crusader
objectives.journal: Something had disturbed the knights' rest before me. Gold scratches on the stone, like the marks of a gauntleted hand. Umaril's servants are hunting the relics too.

objectives.text: Bring the helm to Sir Amiel
objectives.reply: Pelinal's own. I never thought I'd see it. Set it on the altar, beside his cuirass that the Priory has kept all these years. Do you have the gauntlets?

objectives.text: Bring the gauntlets to Sir Amiel
objectives.topic: And the gauntlets. Something else was looking for them.
objectives.reply: Aurorans. Meridia's fallen warriors, Umaril's servants. Then he is truly stirring. One relic remains: the mace.

quests.outro: I recovered Pelinal's helm and gauntlets from the Ossuary of the Knights. Umaril's Auroran servants are already searching for the rest.

consequence.summary: I recovered Pelinal's helm and gauntlets from the Ossuary of the Knights. Umaril's Auroran servants are already searching for the rest.

quests.title: The Mace of the Crusader
quests.desc: The Ayleids hid Pelinal's Stendarr-blessed mace in Garlas Agea, a ruin near Lake Rumare. Umaril's Aurorans are already inside.

objectives.text: Travel to the Ayleid ruin of Garlas Agea
Destroy the Aurorans searching the ruin
Take the Mace of the Crusader
Bring the mace to Sir Amiel
objectives.topic: The Mace of the Crusader. The Aurorans were a step behind me.
objectives.reply: Only a step. They will not get closer. The relics are whole, and so is the order. Now we find Umaril.

quests.outro: I took the Mace of the Crusader from Garlas Agea ahead of Umaril's Aurorans. The relics of Pelinal Whitestrake are gathered at the Priory.

consequence.summary: I took the Mace of the Crusader from Garlas Agea ahead of Umaril's Aurorans. The relics of Pelinal Whitestrake are gathered at the Priory.

quests.title: Umaril the Unfeathered
quests.desc: Umaril the Unfeathered has taken flesh again in Garlas Malatar, the ruin where his last followers waited. Sir Amiel has blessed the relics. It is time to fight him.

objectives.text: Travel to Garlas Malatar
Cut through Umaril's Auroran guard
Strike down Umaril the Unfeathered

quests.outro: I struck down Umaril's body in Garlas Malatar, but his spirit escaped to Meridia's realm. He is not finished.

consequence.summary: I struck down Umaril's body in Garlas Malatar, but his spirit escaped to Meridia's realm. He is not finished.

quests.title: The Divine Crusader
quests.offer: Umaril's spirit escaped. How do I follow it?
quests.pitch: You don't follow it. You call it. Go back to Garlas Malatar under the night sky, wearing Pelinal's blessing, and Umaril's pride will bring his avatar down to meet you. When it falls, nothing of him will return.
quests.desc: The Prophet told me that Umaril's spirit will come down to face me in Garlas Malatar under the night sky. If I destroy his avatar there, he will never return.

objectives.text: Return to Garlas Malatar
Wait for night
Destroy the avatar of Umaril
Return to Sir Amiel at the Priory
objectives.topic: Umaril is gone. All of him.
objectives.reply: I heard the bells, even from here. The order is yours to lead, Divine Crusader. I'll be proud to serve under you.

quests.outro: I destroyed Umaril's avatar and ended him for good. Sir Amiel named me Divine Crusader, head of the Knights of the Nine.

consequence.summary: I destroyed Umaril's avatar and ended him for good. Sir Amiel named me Divine Crusader, head of the Knights of the Nine.
